title: Add independent regression coverage for conflicting MIDI routes and playback states
scope: Complete the executable contract for two confirmed GP8 limits: a single connection port and exclusive mute/solo playback state. Preserve the existing primary-port and mute precedence and verify the exact resulting consumer values.
acceptance: Use separate valid public scores for Channel=1/EffectChannel=18, Mute=true/Solo=true, and both conflicts together. Assert one scoped normalization entry per conflict with correct track location.

Assert exact GPIF Port=0, PrimaryChannel=1, SecondaryChannel=2 for the port conflict and PlaybackState=Mute for the state conflict. A raw pinned consumer must report port=0, primaryChannel=1, secondaryChannel=2, isMute=true, isSolo=false when both apply.

RequirePreservation must return zero bytes and ExportLossError for each unallowed conflict. Allowing one conflict must leave the other blocked; allowing both must emit the documented target values without mutating source values.

Retain same-port/different-channel and nonconflicting Default/Mute/Solo cases as passing preservation controls. Record the two explicit target limits in the work-item resolution without upgrading export to full support.
exclusions: No additional public routing fields or invented XML destination.
Changing precedence or adding simultaneous mute/solo playback semantics is outside this ticket.

reproduction.instructions: Extend the existing M05 regression coverage. Current TestReviewedMetadataTempoLossesAreReported checks report presence only; TestConformancePlaybackRouting covers channels 18/19 sharing port 1 and mute without solo. For the embedded temporary Go harness, first run mkdir -p /tmp/investigation-conversion; use t.TempDir when converting it to permanent tests. The raw consumer command below runs from the repository root after conformance dependencies are installed; replace /absolute/path/to/output.gp with the exported archive.
